description: This file defines an abstract class 'JdbcElement' used for representing JDBC-related configuration elements in the OFBiz framework. It processes XML elements to extract 'isolation-level' attribute and line number information.

classes.name: JdbcElement
classes.description: An abstract class representing JDBC datasource configuration elements, providing methods to access 'isolation-level' and line number information.

methods.name: JdbcElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by extracting 'isolation-level' attribute and 'startLine' user data from an XML element.

methods.name: getIsolationLevel
methods.description: Returns the isolation level attribute value.

methods.name: getLineNumber
methods.description: Returns the configuration file line number associated with this element.
